column2: Captain Zhao and his troopers arrive on Vilon Station were they are introduced to director Patel and encounter a number of unwelcome guests.
Gather Zhao's squad in the cargo bay
Log in to the Cargo Bay Terminal
Meet the director in the control room
Kill all Arachnids in the Lower Levels
Extinguish all fires before the timer expires

// NAME: // Note: Don't translate names starting with #

column2: Stay together, until we know the situation here.
Fall in. We're not here for R&R!

// NAME: // ============== /FLOOR 1: GATHER SQUAD/TRIGGERS/B) LOG IN TO THE TERMINAL/BRIEFING ==============

column2: The control room. Let’s hope someone has answers for us here.
The alert's locked the security doors, but we can open them at that computer panel.

// NAME: // ============== /FLOOR 1: GATHER SQUAD/TRIGGERS/CARGO BAY EVENTS/BUG BREAKOUT/START EXTINGUISHING 2 ==============

column2: Bugs?! How did they get on board?

// NAME: // ============== /FLOOR 1: GATHER SQUAD/TRIGGERS/CARGO BAY EVENTS/MERC ENCOUNTER/CARGO BAY ==============

column2: Company mercenaries? If they’re here, why does HephaeStar Corp need us
Captain Zhao? I'm Director Patel. Please gather your troops, and meet me in the control room.
The great Vilon Station, where “commerce and industry meet”. They certainly sell it better on the ads.
A security alert? What's happening here?
What kind of shoddy security operation are HephaeStar running here!?
Mercenary rabble. That explains a lot.
Everyone here? Then maybe Director Patel can tell us about her Bug problem.
Captain Zhao, you've arrived just in time--
There are Arachnids on your station, ma'am. I’ll need to call this in to Terran Command.
That won’t be necessary, Captain. I have a more urgent concern right now. There are fires that have broken out on the maintenance levels
I was reliably informed that you would be up to any task thrown at you, Captain. That is what the Mobile Infantry does, is it not?
Good. I have a firefighter crew on standby. They'll handle the flames. I need you to keep them protected.
More Bugs! How are they getting onto the station?
We'll investigate that later. Right now, I need those fires put out.

// NAME: // ============== /FLOOR 2: CORRIDORS/TRIGGERS/DOOR CONTROL ROOM/PLAYER AT PIPE ROOM ==============

column2: Hey fellas, open this door for us? We'll handle whatever's in there.
Keep walking, Fed man. You didn't see this.
Pacified Arachnids? What are they doing down here?
I want answers, but right now this station's safety is our priority.
More Bugs coming out of the vents!
We're fighting the fires. And the Bugs. They turned the room ahead into a bit of an inferno.
I'm sending you another team of firefighters. Make sure they stay protected.
The danger isn't over. Temperature levels are still high in the waste processing center.
You want us to help you deal with burning garbage? What about your mercenaries?
The Sky Marshal ordered you to fully cooperate, captain. Please do so.
Our waste incinerators. They must be attracted to the heat. You have my permission to destroy the machines if necessary, captain.
We don’t need permission to kill Bugs.

// NAME: // ============== /FLOOR 3: KILL & EXTINGUISH ALL/TRIGGERS/ENTER THE LAST FIRES ROOM ==============

column2: Careful! Bugs could be hiding in this smoke.
Let's show these civilians how the Mobile Infantry gets the job done.
*cough* My people can barely breath in here!
That level is directly above our nuclear reactor. If fire damages the cooling system...
Releasing enough radiation to render this station uninhabitable. So please hurry, captain.
All fires extinguished. Thank you, captain. You and your people are to report to the cargo bay.
The station's secure again. You can continue your deployment to Gehenna.
I saw Bugs under the control of your mercenaries. What exactly are you people doing here?
Did the Sky Mashal brief you on any classified operations being conducted here, captain?
Then that's because he decided you don't need to know. You're here to follow my orders and kill Bugs. Understood?
Troopers! Gear-up and board your boats. We're going down to the surface!
